examples.text: samaṇo'pi kho, vāseṭṭha, kāyena saṃvuto vācāya saṃvuto manasā saṃvuto sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanam'anvāya diṭṭh'eva dhamme parinibbāyati.

49796.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from bhāveti, caus
49796.meaning2: increase, development by means of thought, meditation

examples.text: disvāna āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ āmantesi, ān'āpānassatiṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. ān'āpānassati, rāhula, bhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā'ti.
dullabhaṃ vā'pi labhanti, cittavūpasame ratā, yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, bhāvanāya rato mano'ti.

49797.grammar: fem, abstr, act, from bhāveti, caus

examples.text: asantaṃ bhāvanam'iccheyya, purekkhārañ'ca bhikkhusu, āvāsesu ca issariyaṃ, pūjā parakulesu ca.

49798.grammar: fem, instr sg of bhāvanā, caus
49798.commentary: (MNa) dassanā pahātabbā'ti dassanena pahātabbā. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, āsavā dassanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā saṃvarā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā paṭisevanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā parivajjanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā vinodanā pahātabbā, atthi āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā.

49799.commentary: (MNt) bhāvanānayo'ti samathavipassanānaṃ yuganaddhabhāvena pavatto bhāvanāvidhi. ayañ'hi ariyamaggakkhaṇe bhāvanāvidhi. tassa pana pubbabhāge bhāvanānayo kassaci samathapubbaṅ'gamo hoti, kassaci vipassanāpubbaṅ'gamo'ti.

examples.text: tena vuttaṃ yath'ānusandhivasena desanā āgatā'ti. brahmavihāresu pana anupadavaṇṇanā ca bhāvanānayo ca sabbo sabb'ākārena visuddhimagge vutto.
